decisions.reason: As an adjustable cardboard quarter-pallet display, it remains tightly aligned with the firm's core POS display business and service-based execution, so it is still worth retaining despite some portfolio-aging risk.
The pegboard-back cardboard display is a useful variant within the firm's established paper-based display range and supports customer choice without stretching capabilities.
This cardboard quarter-pallet display still fits the focused core offer, but its overlap with other quarter-pallet formats makes it the most exposed to future rationalisation.
